plan.goal: Dose APAP at a 0.5 mM working concentration from a 500 mM DMSO stock and verify the DMSO vehicle fraction stays within solvent-toxicity limits.
plan.rationale: APAP is dosed at 0.5 mM working concentration from a 500 mM DMSO stock. The 1/1000 dilution gives 0.1% v/v DMSO in the final medium, which is below the ~0.5% v/v solvent-toxicity guideline (effects begin at 0.5%) and at the 0.1% recommended ceiling for primary cells. A matched vehicle control (0.1% DMSO) is required to isolate APAP-specific effects from any solvent contribution. This is a plate-based dosing design; no chip geometry or perfusion is involved.
caveats: 0.1% v/v DMSO is at the recommended ceiling for primary cells — consider a higher-concentration stock or lower working dose if primary hepatocytes are used.
Confirm the APAP stock is fully dissolved in DMSO before dilution.
Include a matched 0.1% DMSO vehicle control to isolate APAP-specific effects.
Verify the actual DMSO lot/stock concentration in the lab before preparing the dilution.
